obligation: Register with the ODPC as a data controller and renew before expiry
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.18; Data Protection (Registration of Data Controllers and Data Processors) Regulations 2021
applicability_reason: The Club decides how member, staff and visitor data is used and is above the registration thresholds.

obligation: Process personal data only on a lawful basis and in line with the data protection principles
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.25 and s.30
applicability_reason: The Club processes personal data of members, guests, staff and caddies daily.

obligation: Tell people what data is collected, why, and their rights (privacy notices, CCTV signs)
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.29
applicability_reason: Data is collected at membership, bookings, the gate and through the app and chatbot.
due_rule: Reviewed annually and before any new collection

obligation: Handle data subject requests (access, correction, deletion, objection) within the prescribed time
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.26; Data Protection (General) Regulations 2021
applicability_reason: Members and staff can exercise their rights at any time.
due_rule: Within the period set in the General Regulations

obligation: Notify the ODPC of a personal data breach within 72 hours, and affected people without undue delay where there is real risk of harm
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.43
applicability_reason: The Club holds large volumes of member and staff data in cloud systems.

obligation: Carry out a data protection impact assessment before high-risk processing
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.31
applicability_reason: CCTV, the ANPR pilot and the Kijani Assist chatbot are likely high-risk processing.

obligation: Use written contracts with data processors that require security and confidentiality
source: Data Protection Act 2019; Data Protection (General) Regulations 2021
applicability_reason: FairwayOne, the payroll bureau, Sauti AI Labs and the ICT firm process data for the Club.

obligation: Transfer personal data outside Kenya only with appropriate safeguards
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.48 and s.49
applicability_reason: Member data is hosted in South Africa (AS-07); the chatbot uses a foreign model provider.

obligation: Designate a Data Protection Officer
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.24
applicability_reason: Designation is permitted rather than always required; the Club designates one as good practice given its CCTV and member data.

obligation: Use personal data for marketing only with consent or a valid opt-out
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.37; Data Protection (General) Regulations 2021
applicability_reason: The Club sends event and promotion messages to members and guests.

obligation: Keep personal data no longer than necessary and dispose of it securely
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.39
applicability_reason: Records of former members, applicants and CCTV footage build up over time.

obligation: Put in place procedures to prevent bribery appropriate to the Club's size
source: Bribery Act 2016, s.9
applicability_reason: The Club buys goods and services, awards contracts and admits members.

obligation: Report knowledge or suspicion of bribery to the authorities within the required time
source: Bribery Act 2016, s.14
applicability_reason: Managers in a private entity hold positions of authority under the Act.
due_rule: Within 24 hours of knowledge or suspicion

obligation: Give every employee a written contract with the required particulars
source: Employment Act 2007, s.9 and s.10
applicability_reason: The Club employs about 165 people (AS-04).
due_rule: Before or at the start of employment

obligation: Keep employment records for the required period
source: Employment Act 2007, s.74
applicability_reason: The Club employs staff on payroll.

obligation: Issue a policy statement on sexual harassment
source: Employment Act 2007, s.6
applicability_reason: The Club has more than 20 employees.

obligation: Register the workplace with the Directorate of Occupational Safety and Health
source: Occupational Safety and Health Act 2007, s.44
applicability_reason: The clubhouse, kitchens, workshops and course are workplaces.

obligation: Run a health and safety committee
source: Occupational Safety and Health Act 2007, s.9
applicability_reason: The Club has more than 20 workers.

obligation: Carry out and record workplace risk assessments
source: Occupational Safety and Health Act 2007, s.6
applicability_reason: Kitchens, chemicals, machinery and course work create hazards.

obligation: Carry out an annual fire safety audit and fire drills
source: Factories and Other Places of Work (Fire Risk Reduction) Rules 2007
applicability_reason: The clubhouse hosts large events and has commercial kitchens.

obligation: Insure employees against work injury and report injuries
source: Work Injury Benefits Act 2007, s.7 and s.21
applicability_reason: Grounds staff, kitchen staff and others face injury risk.
due_rule: Policy renewal date; reports within the prescribed time

obligation: Deduct and remit PAYE
source: Income Tax Act (Cap 470); Tax Procedures Act 2015
applicability_reason: The Club pays salaries.
due_rule: By the 9th of the following month

obligation: File VAT returns and pay VAT
source: Value Added Tax Act 2013
applicability_reason: The Club is VAT-registered (AS-05).
due_rule: By the 20th of the following month

obligation: Remit NSSF, SHIF and Affordable Housing Levy deductions
source: NSSF Act 2013; Social Health Insurance Act 2023; Affordable Housing Act 2024
applicability_reason: The Club has employees on payroll.

obligation: Keep tax records for the required period
source: Tax Procedures Act 2015, s.23
applicability_reason: The Club files tax returns.

obligation: Hold a current county single business permit
source: Kiambu County finance and trade laws
applicability_reason: The Club trades in Kiambu County (AS-03).

obligation: Hold a current liquor licence for the bars and events
source: Kiambu County alcoholic drinks control law
applicability_reason: The Club sells alcohol in two bars and at events.

obligation: Hold food hygiene licences and keep food handlers' medical certificates current
source: Public Health Act (Cap 242); Food, Drugs and Chemical Substances Act (Cap 254)
applicability_reason: The Club runs a restaurant, bars and banqueting kitchen.

obligation: Hold a water abstraction permit for the borehole and record water use
source: Water Act 2016 and its rules
applicability_reason: The course is irrigated from a borehole (AS-08).
due_rule: By the permit expiry; readings each month

obligation: Carry out an annual environmental self-audit
source: Environmental Management and Co-ordination Act 1999; Environmental (Impact Assessment and Audit) Regulations 2003
applicability_reason: Course maintenance, chemicals and waste have environmental impact.

obligation: Use only registered pest control products, applied by trained staff
source: Pest Control Products Act (Cap 346)
applicability_reason: Greenkeeping uses pesticides and herbicides.

obligation: File annual returns, keep statutory registers and hold the AGM
source: Companies Act 2015
applicability_reason: The Club is a company limited by guarantee (AS-02).
due_rule: Within the statutory period after year end

obligation: Follow the Club's Articles and Bylaws on elections, committee meetings and reporting to members
source: Club Articles of Association and Bylaws
applicability_reason: These are the Club's own binding rules.

obligation: Meet card payment security requirements
source: Merchant agreement with the Club's bank (PCI DSS)
applicability_reason: The Club takes card payments at the clubhouse and pro shop.
due_rule: Annual self-assessment by the date in the agreement

obligation: Engage only a licensed private security provider
source: Private Security Regulation Act 2016
applicability_reason: Guarding is outsourced to Linda Guard Services.
due_rule: Before contract and at each renewal

obligation: Follow golf union affiliation and handicap rules
source: Affiliation rules of the national golf union
applicability_reason: The Club runs handicapped competitions for members.
owner_role: Captain and Membership and Events Manager

obligation: Report suspicious transactions as a reporting institution
source: Proceeds of Crime and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2009
applicability_reason: The Club is not a reporting institution (AS-06). Review if it adds a casino, betting or similar activity.
